name: @internal/github-sdk-fetch-proxy
description: Opt-in HTTP-proxy support for the GitHub fetch layer — the one package that owns an HTTP stack, so the three fetch packages keep their dependency lists (PRD 0002, D1). Import it once and every client honors `proxy`, GITHUB_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --outDir dist/esm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --module CommonJS --moduleResolution Node10 --outDir dist/cjs && node ../scripts/fixup-dist.mjs .

author: GitHub API Module
